script_text: The stars align to force Leo into a confrontation they've been avoiding. Mars enters your 1st House Monday, igniting your ruling fire element with raw confidence. Mercury forms a trine to Uranus on Tuesday, sharpening instincts for bold career moves. The Sun transiting your 10th House keeps your professional status in the spotlight. Wednesday marks the turning point as Venus enters your 7th House, pivoting toward love. This Venus in Libra aspect activates your partnership sector in unexpected ways. Thursday through Sunday, Mars fuels your 1st House creatively. Sunday's sextile to Neptune opens a window for spiritual reflection. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House bringing romantic clarity. Friday is your warning day as Mars squares Saturn, testing authority figures. Trust your instincts — they're leading you somewhere real. Follow for daily updates.
